integrity: Two independent graph census algorithms and two independent signed-base digit recurrences; signed integer boundary checks and full cycle witnesses provided.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete finite classification for negative bases -11 through -20; no general all-base theorem, and earlier unindexed computations cannot be excluded.
source_ids: Grundman, Closing an Open Problem on Negative Base Happy Numbers, Fibonacci Quarterly 62(2), May 2024
title: Complete periodic-orbit and nearest-happy spectra in the next ten negative bases
